reason: It's card-only in dollars, and I pay for almost everything through Click, Payme or Kaspi, so paying would be a hassle and feels risky. Before I give money to a site I've never heard of, I'd use the free part and ask in my Telegram study-abroad groups whether anyone has actually used it.
objection: Paying $99 online by international card to an unknown foreign service: if something goes wrong, how do I really get that refund back to a Kaspi or Payme account?
would_change_my_mind: Being able to pay through Click, Payme or Kaspi in local currency, plus a couple of real parents in my Telegram channels saying it worked for them and the refund is real.
